question: Puneet walks 4 m towards the west. He turns right and walks 7 m. He turns left and walks 4 m. He again turns left and walks 7 m. He turns right and walks 3 m. In which direction is he facing now? (All turns are 90 degree turns only)
solution:
Given:

Puneet walks 4 m towards the west.

He turns right and walks 7 m.

He turns left and walks 4 m.

He again turns left and walks 7 m.

He turns right and walks 3 m.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f4853ecf080cd2fb5ffecfeef0e195a5bb34cf6942efb7b9e4c3bdae488d9150.png] 

Thus, he is facing west direction now.

Hence, the correct answer is** " Option 1 ".**
